meta.title: Private villas in Bali
meta.description: Book private villas directly from the people who run them, with live rates and availability.

home.title: Quiet places, cared for with heart.
home.intro: Private villas with a pool, breakfast and a team that looks after every guest. Book direct at the best rate.

auth.loginIntro: Staff only. Accounts are created by an admin; there is no public sign-up.
auth.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.backupCodeIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each code works once.
auth.setPasswordIntro: Choose a password for your staff account. This link works only once.
auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence you can remember is safer than a short random word.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.noStaff: This account is not linked to an active staff member. Contact your admin.
errors.missingToken: This link is incomplete or has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.

ops.title: Operations
ops.noProperties: No properties have been assigned to you yet.
ops.comingNext: Next: villa status and housekeeping, changing stay dates, and reports.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.intro: Every staff account must use an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
security.enabled: Two-step verification is on for this account.
security.step2: 2. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.manualKey: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:
security.step3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
security.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Store them somewhere safe now; they will not be shown again.
